newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Pakistani for heroin smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Pakistani for heroin smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising the number of people executed so far this year to 81.

An Interior Ministry statement published by the official Saudi Press Agency said the man was executed in the capital Riyadh after a court found him guilty of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin into the conservative kingdom.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. A total of 68 people were beheaded in 1996.
